title: fix(plugin-list): keep formula fields out of the Group editors, and fall back from a refused personal grouping
body:
Fixes #32631

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:列表视图的两个「分组」编辑器(工具栏分组面板与「显示」面板的分组区)不再提供公式字段;用户自己带来的分组(URL 里的 `uf__group`)若含公式字段,列表去掉该层后照常显示,并在上方给出一行提示和「从分组中移除」按钮。
- 为什么改:服务端拒绝按公式字段分组(值在读取时计算、无存储列),界面却照样提供该选项,用户点一下整个列表就变成「数据加载失败」,且因分组存在 URL 里一直坏着。
- 风险与回滚:仅前端;视图作者自己声明的公式分组仍按原样查询、仍显示错误(那是元数据缺陷,应由作者看到)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`(`unstoredGroupingFields` 与查询所用 `groupingConfig` 的推导)、`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx`(`groupFieldOptions`)、`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.harness.test.tsx` 末尾的新块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.harness.test.tsx -t groupPickerUnstored`,预期 7 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The Group editors offer no virtual field.** `ListView`'s field list (`allFields`) marks a field the object declares virtual with `groupable: false`, judged by the spec's `isVirtualSearchField`, the very predicate the server's aggregate door (`assertGroupByTargetsAreStored` in `packages/objectql/src/aggregate-query-shape-door.ts`) calls. No local type list. A new helper `groupFieldOptions` in `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` builds the options for BOTH editors, the Display popover's Group section and the wide toolbar's Group panel, so the two forms cannot drift. The field is withheld, not shown disabled. A level that already names one is still shown, because `GroupingEditor` mounts a value its options lack, so the level can be removed. Hide fields and Row color still list the field.
- **A refused grouping the reader brought falls back.** The state the editors edit is now `chosenGroupingConfig`. What the list queries with and hands to the grid is the derived `groupingConfig`, which is the chosen value minus every level the reader added that names a virtual field. If nothing is dropped, `groupingConfig` is the chosen value itself, with the same identity. A reduced value is cached on the chosen value plus the dropped names, never on a memo identity (AGENTS.md #10), because the fetch effect re-runs on it. A notice line (`list-grouping-unstored-notice`, `role="status"`) names the field(s). Its button (`list-grouping-unstored-remove`) writes the reduced grouping through `changeGrouping`, the editors' own door, so the console's URL loses the level.
- **Personal vs declared, and which way each went.** "The view's own" grouping is `viewDefaults.grouping` when the host passes it, which the console's list renderer does with `listSchema.grouping` under the URL seed. Otherwise it is the schema's grouping, plus the `groupBy` / `groupBy2` shorthand either way. A level whose field is in that set is queried as declared. The server refusal then still shows as the grid's error panel: it is a metadata defect, and its author must see it. Ruling A (`gridOwnsGroupedFetch`) and ruling F (`groupingNeedsHeaderQuery`) are untouched and read the derived `groupingConfig`. A fully dropped grouping therefore takes the flat-list path, and a data source with no `queryGroupHeaders` is still refused before mount for any grouping that remains.
- **i18n:** two keys in every pack, `list.groupingUnstoredNotice` and `list.groupingUnstoredRemove`. `zh-Hant` is regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`. The `@object-ui/i18n` entry exports `en` and `TranslationKeys = typeof en`, so this widens the published surface (Clause-② yes, widening). Nothing is removed.
- The server refusal and the request the client sends for a declared grouping are unchanged.

## Tests

New top-level block `ListView.groupPickerUnstored-32631` at the end of the shared harness `ListView.harness.test.tsx` (it registers a grid stand-in, so it sits after the blocks that register nothing):

- Picker: the toolbar Group panel and the Display popover's Group section each seed "Add group field" with the first STORED field, and the level's options are `Subject, Status` with `Title` (formula) withheld. CONTROL: with the same field typed `text`, `Title` is offered first.
- Fallback: a personal grouping by the formula alone hands the grid no grouping, draws the notice naming `Title`, and its button reports `undefined`. Personal `[status, display_title]` hands the grid `[status]`, and the button reports `{ fields: [status] }`. CONTROL: the view declares the same grouping, so it is handed down as declared and no notice is drawn. CONTROL: the reader groups by the field stored, so it is handed down and no notice is drawn.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** The claim gave `ListView.tsx` "the refused-grouping fallback only". Measuring showed the picker cannot be fixed in `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` alone. The field types are read only in `ListView` (`objectDef`), and the popover is handed `{ name, label }`. The wide toolbar's twin Group panel also lives in `ListView`, and the popover's header says to change both forms together. So `ListView.tsx` also carries the `groupable` mark in `allFields`, the wide panel's `groupFieldOptions(allFields)`, and the editor-facing reads moved to `chosenGroupingConfig`. No file outside the claimed list is touched. `objectViewListRenderer.tsx` (PR #32629) is not touched: the console already hands `viewDefaults.grouping`.
- The plugin-list package suite was narrowed locally to the grouping and popover files plus the whole harness, because the shared verify lock queue was saturated. The full `Test UI` run is CI's.
- Withheld rather than disabled-with-reason. The sort picker withholds platform-unsortable fields silently the same way, and an in-use level stays removable.

## Verification
